consistency_lock.height_anchor:
[HEIGHT & PROPORTION OPTIMIZATION]
Body Proportion: the same 168 cm tall adult woman, slim build, seven-and-a-half head-to-body ratio,
small head, long neck, long unbroken leg line, natural anatomical proportions. Preserve her original
anatomical identity and body structure from the reference image. Do not lengthen the legs, shorten
the torso, narrow the waist or widen the shoulders.
Camera Perspective: full-body fashion photography with the camera positioned at waist level and a
three-degree upward tilt. Keep the horizon level. Avoid steep low-angle perspectives, high-angle
shots, downward tilting and strong foreshortening.
Lens: 50mm equivalent fashion-editorial perspective, realistic depth, natural perspective
compression. Avoid wide-angle distortion and oversized foreground elements.
Composition: full body head to toe, the figure fills 76 percent of the frame height, crown of the
head 12 percent below the top edge, soles of the shoes 12 percent above the bottom edge. Both feet
remain completely visible and grounded. Identical camera distance and subject scale across the whole
set.
Posture: the pose described below is the only variable between images. Spine, shoulder and pelvis
alignment change with the pose, never with the camera.
Visual Silhouette: one clean continuous line from the shoulders through the waist, hips, knees and
ankles, with the thighs, knees, calves and ankles clearly distinguishable and the two legs never
merging into a single mass.
Anatomical Integrity: realistic human anatomy, natural joint positions, consistent limb lengths and
the original body structure. No artificial body stretching, disproportionate limbs, distorted feet,
distorted joints or exaggerated anatomical modifications.
[END HEIGHT & PROPORTION OPTIMIZATION]
consistency_lock.setting_lock: seamless mid-gray studio backdrop with a soft vertical gradient, clean floor plane, soft directional key light from the front left with gentle fill, natural skin texture
consistency_lock.negative: no square-on symmetric stance, no arms hanging straight down symmetrically, no parallel feet, no varying subject scale, no cropped feet, no zoomed-in torso, no exaggerated limb elongation, no text, no graphics, no props, no other people
consistency_lock.why_50mm: 35mm o ngang hong keo dai chan qua muc va lam nguoi mau doc thanh ~175cm; 85mm nen phang va lam mat do sau. 50mm o ngang hong + tilt 3 do giu duoc chan dai ma khong pha ti le 168cm.
consistency_lock.macro_note: height_anchor la ban dieu chinh cua [HEIGHT & PROPORTION OPTIMIZATION] trong try-on-image-prompter.md: 50mm thay 70mm, 76% thay 82-85%. Chen NGUYEN VAN vao moi prompt trong mot bo. prompt_lint.py nhan header nay.

weight_and_torso.torso: leaning slightly back and to her left, chest closed by the crossed arms rather than hollowed
weight_and_torso.hip_chest_rotation: hip out to the standing side, chest squared but tilted

limbs.right_hand: tucked under the opposite biceps inside the crossed arm stack, fingers out of sight
limbs.left_hand: tucked under the opposite biceps, right forearm stacked over the left
limbs.legs: standing right leg straight and weight-bearing, left leg crossed in front with the knee bent, ankle rolled, foot resting on the ball with the heel lifted

head_and_gaze.head: tilted strongly to her right, chin pushed slightly forward and down, face three-quarter toward camera
head_and_gaze.gaze: up and into the lens from under the tilt
head_and_gaze.expression: eyes soft and direct, mouth closed with a faint smirk

poses.prompt_core: Her body is turned about twenty degrees off the camera axis. Both arms are folded high across her chest with the right forearm stacked over the left and both hands tucked under the opposite biceps so the fingers stay out of sight. Weight is on her right leg with the hip pushed out to that side, the left leg loosely crossing forward with the knee bent, the ankle rolled, the foot resting on the ball with the heel lifted off the floor. The torso leans slightly back and to her left with the chest closed by the crossed arms, shoulders kept level and relaxed against the arms. Head tilted strongly to her right, chin pushed slightly forward and down, face three-quarter toward the camera, eyes soft and looking up into the lens from under the tilt, mouth closed with a faint smirk.

camera.framing: full-body head to toe with the shoes visible and a clean floor band beneath, modest headroom
camera.lens_effect: compression so the pose reads flat and the proportions stay true
camera.applies_to: single-shot only; in a multi-image set the lock overrides this

weight_and_torso.weight: loaded on her left leg, hips level to slightly hiked on that side, right leg crossing over in front
weight_and_torso.shoulders: relaxed and even with a tiny drop on the camera-left side
weight_and_torso.torso: upright with a slight lean toward the weighted hip, chest open
weight_and_torso.hip_chest_rotation: hips rotated slightly toward camera left, gentle twist between shoulders and pelvis

limbs.right_hand: hanging down beside the thigh, fingers relaxed and slightly curled
limbs.left_hand: slid into the front jeans pocket, thumb hooked outside, elbow bent softly against the body
limbs.legs: right leg crossed over the left in front with the knee bent, foot placed on the ball with the heel lifted, left leg straight and weight-bearing with the toe pointing slightly out
limbs.stance_width: narrow, the front foot resting on the ball just ahead of the standing shin

head_and_gaze.head: level with a subtle tilt to her right
head_and_gaze.gaze: direct calm eye contact with the lens
head_and_gaze.expression: chin neutral, lips closed in a soft neutral expression

poses.prompt_core: Her body is rotated about twenty-five degrees so the shoulders and hips sit at a three-quarter angle, weight loaded on her left leg with the hips level to slightly hiked on that side, and the right leg crosses over in front with the knee bent, the foot placed on the ball with the heel lifted off the floor, the left toe pointing slightly out. Torso upright with a slight lean toward the weighted hip, chest open, hips rotated toward the camera to create a gentle twist between shoulders and pelvis, shoulders relaxed and even with a small drop on the far side. Her right hand hangs down beside the thigh with the fingers relaxed and slightly curled, the left hand slid into the front pocket with the thumb hooked outside and the elbow bent softly against the body. Head level with a subtle tilt, calm direct eye contact with the lens, chin neutral, lips closed in a soft neutral expression.
